major_cooldowns.name: Dragonrage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open with it and use it roughly every two minutes, since it guarantees Essence Burst from Living Flame and Azure Strike for its duration.

major_cooldowns.name: Deep Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown and cancel the flight the instant you reach the target with the cancel macro; if you have a second charge from Strafing Run, delay it until that buff is about to expire in single target, or send both back to back in AoE.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table shows 433874 as the current cast id (5/5 parses); 357210 shares the name but was not cast in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at rank 1 by default and save charges to weave two casts inside Dragonrage so Animosity extends the buff.

major_cooldowns.name: Eternity Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower it to match your current target count, and if your on-pull Dragonrage would run under 38 seconds, hold this cast to use inside Dragonrage instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it inside Dragonrage to instantly max-rank Eternity Surge; if playing Flameshaper, never spend it on Fire Breath since that is a large damage loss.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of the Aspects
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Coordinate its use with your raid's other haste cooldowns since it is off the global cooldown and shares its Exhaustion debuff with other haste effects.

defensives.name: Verdant Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to heal yourself or an ally between casts without overhealing, which also fills your Scarlet Adaptation buff.
defensives.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; likely a talent-gated heal choice.

rules.description: Dragonrage, Tip the Scales, Eternity Surge, Fire Breath
rules.action: Fire Dragonrage first, then Tip the Scales, Eternity Surge, and Fire Breath in that order to set up the burst window.

rules.description: Save Pyre for triple-cast inside Dragonrage
rules.action: Hold Pyre in the last few seconds before Dragonrage so its stacked Charged Blast value carries into the three Pyres Dragonrage fires.

rules.description: Eternity Surge and Fire Breath saved for Dragonrage
rules.action: Save Eternity Surge and Fire Breath when Dragonrage is close so you can weave them inside it and extend the buff with Animosity.
Start working Pyre into the priority once you have three or more targets.
Spend Essence Burst through Disintegrate or Pyre as soon as it is up instead of letting it sit.
Cast Living Flame while Burnout is up instead of Azure Strike or Azure Sweep.

rules.description: Refresh Fire Breath DoT without clipping
rules.action: Only refresh Fire Breath once its damage-over-time debuff has 30% or less duration remaining.
